public_payload.normalized_proposition: Google, Amazon and Microsoft are spending hundreds of billions on capex mostly to bring in around $440 billion in revenue from Anthropic and OpenAI over the next three years, and those two will make up more than 70% of their AI revenues in that period and more than 48% of Google Cloud's 2027 revenue.

statement.excerpt: Google, Amazon and Microsoft are currently spending hundreds of billions of dollars on capex to, for the most part, pull in around $440 billion in revenue in the next three years from Anthropic and OpenAI, as they represent more than 70% of their AI revenues in the next three years, and more than 48% of Google Cloud’s 2027 revenue.

from_speaker: currently spending hundreds of billions of dollars on capex
more than 70% of their AI revenues
more than 48% of Google Cloud’s 2027 revenue
our_interpretation: Read the three-year forecast as covering September 1, 2026 through September 1, 2029. The separately stated Google Cloud share concerns calendar 2027.
Read $440 billion as aggregate realized revenue received by the three suppliers from the two named customers. Contract commitments, financing and annualized revenue are not substitutes.
Read the 70% threshold as the two customers' combined share of the three suppliers' aggregate AI revenue. The wording could alternatively mean each supplier separately.
The phrase 'for the most part' qualifies the purpose of capital spending; it is not a conditional antecedent.
The supplied passage does not identify an accounting basis or explain how the estimates were constructed. Do not infer one from similar estimates found elsewhere.
The capital-spending amount and its alleged purpose are additional components. Revenue concentration alone would not establish the purpose of most capital spending.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable customer-level accounts establish approximately $440 billion of realized revenue during the three-year interval, a share above 70% of aggregate AI revenue during that interval, and a share above 48% of Google Cloud revenue in calendar 2027. Evidence must also substantiate the current capital-spending scale and its claimed predominant purpose.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable completed-period accounts establish failure of a numerical component, allowing for the unspecified approximation around $440 billion; or reliable evidence directly disproves the claimed predominant purpose of capital spending. A shortfall before the deadline does not qualify.
